title: Reset password
body: Open login page -> Forgot password -> enter email -> follow link. Link expires in 24h. If no email, check spam and allowlist our domain.

title: Billing and invoices
body: Go to Settings -> Billing to update card, download invoices, or cancel plan. Refunds and disputes need a human agent.

title: Outage or slowness
body: Check status.example.com. If no incident posted, tell us your region and timestamp; we will investigate.
